decisions.what: Created src/styles/components/button.css with WCAG AA compliant primary CTA styles
decisions.why: Specification targeted src/styles/components/button.css but the src/ path did not exist in this project. Followed the specification path exactly, applying #2C3EF8 background, #FFFFFF text, #2332C6 hover, and a visible focus outline for the .btn-primary and .cta-button selectors as required.

decisions.what: Created src/components/CTAButton.tsx as a polymorphic React CTA button component
decisions.why: Specification targeted src/components/CTAButton.tsx which did not previously exist. Component uses bg-[#2C3EF8]/text-white per spec, references the btn-primary and cta-button CSS classes, adds a default aria-label for screen-reader accessibility, and can render as either a button or an anchor to support common CTA usage.
